_meta.notes: An all-zero filing: every cell on the Summary Page — both columns of Lines 1 and 2 and all of Lines 3-7 — is a hand-drawn slashed zero. Party is 'Desert Greens'; District Number reads 'At-Large'. Stamped COPY / RECEIVED OCT 30 2006.

contributions.detail: exact - Schedule A EXISTS and is printed with NO lines filled: the filer wrote 'N/A' in the Date, Name, Address and Occupation cells of row 1, a SLASHED ZERO in that row's Amount cell, and a slashed zero in BOTH the SUBTOTAL and the TOTAL cells, then drew a long wavy line down every column. Under the zero-glyph ruling those slashed zeros are 0, so this is a real zero with zero rows.

expenditures.detail: exact - Schedule B is filled in exactly the same way: 'N/A' across row 1, slashed zeros in the row Amount, SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells, wavy lines down every column.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 SUBTOTAL = a slashed-zero glyph against an empty grid; p4 the same. Nothing to gate and zero rows is correct on both pages. Unlike the other zero filing in this chunk (Rogers), here the grand-total cells ALSO read zero, so there is no cumulative figure to be confused with the period.
itemized.notes: Handwritten form, Chuck Tripp, County Council, Interim Report October 31, form's own Date of Report 10/30/2006. Both schedules are printed but wholly unfilled. The 'N/A' marks are NIL MARKS and are not numerals - they do not become zeros; the ZEROS come from the slashed-zero glyphs in the Amount, SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells, which under the repo's zero-glyph ruling are 0. The row-1 'N/A' line is NOT emitted as an itemized row: it has no date, no payee and no dollar figure, only a nil mark, and 'do not transcribe what is not a field' applies. Honest real zeros on both sides, not gaps.
